overall_explanation:
Reviewed the changed runtime sources (rc03-seal-hook.ts, seal-registry.ts, rc03-producers.ts, stream-resolution.ts, btw.ts, compact.ts, extensions.ts, extension runner, context orchestrator/final snapshot) plus the three new test suites and the doc/rule/spec updates.

Checks out:
- Default-off preserved: RC-03 admission stays opt-in (OPENCLAW_RC03_SEAL=1 or runtime.rc03.seal=true), the enhancement kill switch wins, off paths report sealCoverage=disabled, persist no plan/receipt, and leave request bytes unchanged.
- Creation and enforcement now resolve the same current config via resolveCurrentRc03SealState; historical turn-kill lineage is no longer the enforcement decision.
- Producer/phase facts come from one registry: registrations are frozen copies, the coverage matrix is a derived read-only projection, plan readbacks are structured clones, admission goes through assertSealMutation, unknown applied lineage sources now reach admission instead of being dropped, and session-start-injection / btw-side-question are mapped from real lineage ids.
- Model-call identity is shared between the context producer and the stream wrapper; summarizers take their own index, denied calls do not advance the counter, explicit summary identities are reused rather than renamed, and the sealed digest is always bound with the cache-boundary marker stripped on both sides.
- The context callback binds the live session prompt (ctx.getSystemPrompt()), covering continuations that skip before_agent_start; empty prompts are still hashed.
- Temporary clearing (clearRc03SealPlan) is separated from end-of-run release (releaseRc03Run/endRc03RunAttempts); BTW seals under an ephemeral run identity and releases it in finally; standalone manual compaction falls back to the session identity and releases only what it owns.
- Seal denial propagates structurally through the extension runner (SealMutationError rethrown) while ordinary optional extension failures stay fail-open.
- Docs, harness rule, task-spec wiring, flag catalog and artifact manifest match the code; the matrix has 18 registered rows; default-off, the 6000-char limit and product locks are untouched.

Residual risk noted but not actionable: sealBoundaryModelCall now throws unsealed-model-call for a non-summarizer call without a sealed plan, so a hypothetical call bypassing the orchestrator seal aborts the turn instead of running unverified; this is deliberate fail-closed behavior under an opt-in flag.
